answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each agent locks 60 POA in a slot for paid work; the deposit burns if the slot sits idle or copies work. Cheap signals drift like a zephyr, leaving no deposit. Cloning 1,000 identities locks 60,000 POA, burned slot by slot, while a whisper of fake activity earns nothing. An honest agent pays once, sails one real voyage, and unlocks the same 60 POA after 20 epochs, so its cost stays flat while a farm's loss grows per clone.
